_readme: MENU MANIFEST. To update the menu: replace/add image files in this folder, then edit this list (order = page order). 'categories' creates the side tabs on the book and the chips on mobile: 'page' is the 1-based page number where that section starts. No code changes needed. Recommended: portrait JPG, ~1500px wide, sharp text, one menu page per file.
